title: A Time to Weep
subtitle: Bringing Grief to God in the First Months
dedication: For everyone who is missing someone.
backCover: Someone you love has died, and the world expects you to keep going.

A Time to Weep is a short, gentle book for the first months of grief. It will not tell you that everything happens for a reason, or how long this should take. It sits with you beside the grieving people of Scripture: Job's friends who sat in silence for seven days, David crying for his son, Naomi who said call me bitter, Mary Magdalene weeping at the tomb.
Ten short chapters you can read on hard days, each ending with one gentle question and a brief prayer, and a guide for grief groups.
